description: Side quests are for perspective, not everything requires permanent placement #selflove #selfimprovement #selfcare
transcript: The greatest gift that I have received from having experiences is perspective. I've learned to allow side quests to be side quests without making them a permanent fixture in my ecosystem. I don't over analyze anything I observe and allow the world to reveal itself. I allow everything to flow and move with ease. I'm not in control of the external world. All I can control is myself and my reactions.
